notes: Second run of 2026-08-28. Seven items queued, all seven read. This feed reaches us through the Chronicle's Bluesky account, and two properties of that make it unpublishable as it stands: the item's title is the social post's teaser sentence rather than the article's headline, and the link is a bit.ly shortlink. The headline is the only text of theirs that reaches a page, so a teaser cannot stand in for it, and a shortlink is not a citation anyone can check. The canonical sfchronicle.com URLs are recorded on each finding below, resolved from the shortlinks with the tracking parameters stripped; the headlines still have to come from the articles themselves before any of these can be published. Resolved on 2026-08-30: the article's own headline is carried in its og:title (and, identically, its on-page h1 and sailthru.title), so the three pending findings could be cited under the headlines their articles actually print. The labels below are those headlines; the URLs are the canonical sfchronicle.com ones, unchanged. read.py now reports an article's canonical headline for exactly this reason, so a later Bluesky item does not need this by hand.
